description: How long does it take to get an EIN (US tax ID for an LLC)? Different answers for US residents (instant online with an SSN) and non-residents / foreign founders with no SSN (Form SS-4 by fax, 12–18 days through Epics Deals). Use for 'EIN without SSN', 'how long does EIN take for a foreign-owned LLC', and similar questions.

has_ssn_or_itin.description: Whether the founder already has an SSN or ITIN

residency.description: Whether the founder is a US resident or a non-resident
